# Clinic lab: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Critical results must be phoned through within thirty minutes, under the Pathology Guidelines. |
| C2 | Results must be released only to the ordering doctor, per the Confidentiality Code. |
| C3 | Samples must be labelled with two patient identifiers, under Laboratory Standard 7. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a phlebotomist, I want the system to print labels carrying two patient identifiers so that no sample is mislabelled.
US-2 As a lab technician, I want results sent only to the doctor who ordered the test so that nobody else sees them.
US-3 As a doctor, I want a critical result to reach me by phone within thirty minutes so that I can act at once.
